hypothesis: The accel_step formation window (steps 60-70 at N=64, e in [0, 0.85], lr 0.001, seeds 59-61; f-20261012-034018-5526) is set by the optimizer trajectory, not by the data. Halving lr to 0.0005 with everything else matched (same seeds, data, architecture, best-of-5 controls, 10-step checkpoints) delays persistent formation roughly in proportion.
expected_if_true: Read from trajectories, the persistent 0.1-bar formation step is >= 100 in all 3 seeds (>= 30 steps later than the seed-matched lr=0.001 steps of 60/60/70), and the half-final-margin step is >= 30 steps later than the lr=0.001 value in at least 2 of 3 seeds. Final accel_step margin stays >= 0.2.
expected_if_false: The persistent 0.1-bar step is <= 90 (within 20 steps of the seed-matched lr=0.001 run) in at least 2 of 3 seeds. That would mean formation timing is not driven by learning rate. If the final margin is < 0.15 in 2 or more seeds, the run is undertrained and the result is recorded as inconclusive.
